title: Prove cnf lemmas over a distinct's pairs by propagation
summary: The Lean reconstructor now reads a distinct over terms as its negated pair equalities and projects wide conjunctions from tails, so cnf lemmas like NEQ004's twelve are proved by propagation instead of an unfolded grind. NEQ004's Lean peak memory drops from about 7.06 GB to 5.54 GB on macOS.
